socialpostforge.title: Turn product updates into launch content
socialpostforge.situation: A feature has shipped, but the team only has release notes and screenshots.
socialpostforge.workflow: Add the rough notes or product image, choose a persuasive structure and generate platform-ready variations.
socialpostforge.outcome: Publish a clearer launch story in minutes instead of losing an afternoon to a blank page.

socialpostforge.title: Repurpose one idea across social channels
socialpostforge.situation: A strong idea needs to work on LinkedIn, X and Instagram without sounding copied and pasted.
socialpostforge.workflow: Use the same source material to create channel-aware versions with different lengths, hooks and calls to action.
socialpostforge.outcome: Stay consistent across channels while respecting how people read on each platform.

socialpostforge.title: Build a repeatable founder voice
socialpostforge.situation: Posts are irregular because every draft starts from scratch and the tone changes each time.
socialpostforge.workflow: Choose a preferred style and proven framework, then refine rough observations into a recognizable voice.
socialpostforge.outcome: Publish more consistently without handing personal thought leadership to a generic content agency.

socialpostforge.title: Convert customer wins into proof
socialpostforge.situation: Useful customer outcomes are buried in notes, emails and screenshots.
socialpostforge.workflow: Summarize the result, add supporting context and generate a concise proof-led post without exposing private details.
socialpostforge.outcome: Turn everyday customer evidence into credible social proof that supports sales conversations.

socialpostforge.title: Create campaign variations quickly
socialpostforge.situation: A campaign needs multiple hooks and angles for testing, but writing each variant manually slows experimentation.
socialpostforge.workflow: Generate alternatives using AIDA, PAS or influence principles, then select and edit the strongest candidates.
socialpostforge.outcome: Test more creative angles while keeping the core offer and brand message aligned.

socialpostforge.title: Make visual assets easier to publish
socialpostforge.situation: A polished graphic is ready but the accompanying caption, hook and CTA are not.
socialpostforge.workflow: Use the visual as context, select the desired post style and generate copy that explains why the image matters.
socialpostforge.outcome: Move finished creative into the publishing queue without another writing bottleneck.

execpilot.title: Write decisive executive emails
execpilot.situation: A sensitive decision needs to be communicated clearly without sounding abrupt or evasive.
execpilot.workflow: Provide the context, intended decision and relationship constraints, then refine the message in an executive tone.
execpilot.outcome: Send concise, confident communication that reduces follow-up and preserves trust.

execpilot.title: Handle difficult team conversations
execpilot.situation: Feedback, missed expectations or changing priorities need careful wording.
execpilot.workflow: Outline the facts and desired outcome, then generate a direct but respectful conversation or email draft.
execpilot.outcome: Address issues sooner with language that is specific, fair and easier to act on.

execpilot.title: Improve high-value outreach
execpilot.situation: A cold introduction or partnership request must feel relevant rather than automated.
execpilot.workflow: Add the recipient context, value proposition and desired next step, then create a short personalized message.
execpilot.outcome: Increase the chance of a thoughtful reply without spending excessive time polishing every approach.

execpilot.title: Prepare investor and stakeholder updates
execpilot.situation: Progress, risks and requests are scattered across notes and operational reports.
execpilot.workflow: Summarize the period, choose the important signals and shape them into a structured stakeholder update.
execpilot.outcome: Communicate momentum and problems honestly in a format busy readers can scan quickly.

execpilot.title: Respond quickly without sounding rushed
execpilot.situation: A response is urgent, but a hurried draft could create ambiguity or unnecessary tension.
execpilot.workflow: Drop in the rough reply, select the intended tone and refine it before sending.
execpilot.outcome: Maintain speed and professional judgment at the same time.

execpilot.title: Frame decisions before a meeting
execpilot.situation: A complex choice needs a clear recommendation, trade-offs and decision request.
execpilot.workflow: Capture the options and constraints, apply a decision framework and turn the analysis into a concise briefing.
execpilot.outcome: Spend meeting time deciding rather than reconstructing the problem.

loompath.title: Automate repetitive browser administration
loompath.situation: Staff repeatedly open the same pages, copy fields, update records and confirm completion.
loompath.workflow: Build a workflow from navigation, page-value, transform and form-action steps, then run it on demand or a schedule.
loompath.outcome: Reduce manual handling while preserving a visible, editable process the team can understand.

loompath.title: Monitor pages for operational changes
loompath.situation: A portal or dashboard must be checked regularly for new records, status changes or exceptions.
loompath.workflow: Navigate to the target, extract the relevant values, compare or transform them and notify or trigger a webhook.
loompath.outcome: Catch changes sooner without assigning someone to refresh the same page all day.

loompath.title: Process CSV-driven browser work
loompath.situation: Rows from a file must be entered, checked or enriched through a browser-only system.
loompath.workflow: Load the CSV as structured rows, iterate through each record, perform nested page actions and continue after all rows finish.
loompath.outcome: Turn a fragile copy-and-paste job into a repeatable batch process with visible row context.

loompath.title: Create resilient scraping workflows
loompath.situation: Useful page data must be collected repeatedly, but absolute selectors break whenever the layout shifts.
loompath.workflow: Use recorded semantic selectors and fallbacks, extract into named variables and transform or export the results.
loompath.outcome: Collect structured information with fewer failures and faster debugging when a page changes.

loompath.title: Connect browser systems to business tools
loompath.situation: A legacy portal has no practical API, but downstream systems accept webhooks.
loompath.workflow: Read data from the page, construct the required payload, headers and method, then send JSON, form or multipart requests.
loompath.outcome: Bridge browser-only work into modern workflows without building a full custom integration.

loompath.title: Run conditional multi-path processes
loompath.situation: The next action depends on page values, record type or calculated results.
loompath.workflow: Use nested conditions, switch paths and iterators to model the real decision logic, including fallbacks and continuation.
loompath.outcome: Automate meaningful processes rather than only linear click sequences.

contractguardian.title: Discover undocumented application APIs
contractguardian.situation: A web application exposes useful data, but its network endpoints are not documented.
contractguardian.workflow: Capture requests in DevTools, inspect methods, paths, parameters and responses, then export a usable recipe.
contractguardian.outcome: Move from network archaeology to a repeatable integration starting point.

contractguardian.title: Detect API schema drift
contractguardian.situation: A response changes silently and downstream automation starts failing.
contractguardian.workflow: Save a known-good baseline, compare live traffic and highlight changed, missing or newly introduced fields.
contractguardian.outcome: Identify breaking changes close to their source instead of after a production incident.

contractguardian.title: Validate frontend-backend contracts
contractguardian.situation: Teams disagree about whether the UI, API or consuming code introduced a defect.
contractguardian.workflow: Inspect the actual request and response contract from the running application and compare it with the expected shape.
contractguardian.outcome: Replace assumptions with concrete evidence and shorten cross-team debugging.

contractguardian.title: Generate realistic development fixtures
contractguardian.situation: Tests need representative response structures without manually recreating complex payloads.
contractguardian.workflow: Capture a suitable request, redact sensitive values and export the structure as JSON or JavaScript.
contractguardian.outcome: Create more realistic fixtures while reducing accidental exposure of live data.

contractguardian.title: Document integration behavior
contractguardian.situation: An internal integration works, but nobody has a reliable record of the endpoints and fields involved.
contractguardian.workflow: Observe the live flow, select the meaningful traffic and export concise request-response documentation.
contractguardian.outcome: Give maintainers a practical map of how the application communicates.

contractguardian.title: Turn captured traffic into automation
contractguardian.situation: A proven browser request needs to become a repeatable workflow or programmatic call.
contractguardian.workflow: Capture the request, review its dependencies and export it to JSON, JavaScript, CSV or a LoomPath recipe.
contractguardian.outcome: Reuse working traffic patterns without manually transcribing every header and parameter.

journeylens.title: Record critical checkout journeys
journeylens.situation: A checkout failure is costly, but manual regression checks vary by tester.
journeylens.workflow: Record the real journey with intent, timings, assertions, screenshots and resilient selector fallbacks.
journeylens.outcome: Replay a maintainable test and retain evidence of exactly where the experience changed.

journeylens.title: Create reproducible bug reports
journeylens.situation: A user reports that a process failed, but the written steps omit important context.
journeylens.workflow: Capture the walkthrough, page state, actions, diagnostics and screenshots in one evidence-rich journey.
journeylens.outcome: Give developers a clearer reproduction path and reduce the back-and-forth needed to understand the issue.

journeylens.title: Audit operational browser processes
journeylens.situation: A browser procedure is business-critical but its controls and fragile steps are poorly understood.
journeylens.workflow: Record the process, add assertions and review timing, selector quality, accessibility and risk indicators.
journeylens.outcome: Expose weak points before they become operational incidents.

journeylens.title: Generate maintainable Playwright tests
journeylens.situation: A real user flow needs test coverage, but translating it manually takes too long.
journeylens.workflow: Record the journey with semantic context and export a structured Playwright starting point with fallbacks.
journeylens.outcome: Accelerate automation while preserving enough intent for future maintenance.

journeylens.title: Build visual training evidence
journeylens.situation: New team members need to understand what a correct completed journey looks like.
journeylens.workflow: Capture the real process with screenshots, annotations and redacted training output.
journeylens.outcome: Create more credible learning material from the same evidence used for quality assurance.

journeylens.title: Compare journeys before and after change
journeylens.situation: A redesign or release may have introduced extra friction or hidden regressions.
journeylens.workflow: Record comparable journeys, review action counts, timing, assertions and flagged risks across versions.
journeylens.outcome: Discuss release impact with observable evidence instead of impressions alone.

airlock.title: Sanitize logs before sharing with AI
airlock.situation: Logs contain useful diagnostic context alongside tokens, emails or internal identifiers.
airlock.workflow: Scan locally, review detected secrets and PII, then redact, mask or pseudonymize before pasting.
airlock.outcome: Use external assistance without casually disclosing credentials or customer information.

airlock.title: Protect credentials in support tickets
airlock.situation: A copied configuration or error report may include passwords, keys or private account details.
airlock.workflow: Check the text before submission and replace sensitive values while retaining enough structure for diagnosis.
airlock.outcome: Reduce preventable exposure without stripping the ticket of useful technical evidence.

airlock.title: Guard AI prompts in the browser
airlock.situation: A prompt contains confidential names, project terms or personal information that should not leave the organization.
airlock.workflow: Apply local rules and optional on-device classification before the form is submitted.
airlock.outcome: Introduce a practical last-mile privacy control at the point where data is most likely to leak.

airlock.title: Enforce internal terminology rules
airlock.situation: Specific project names, customer identifiers or regulated terms must not be submitted to external sites.
airlock.workflow: Configure internal terms, scan form content and warn, sanitize or block based on policy.
airlock.outcome: Turn written handling guidance into an actionable browser safeguard.

airlock.title: Prepare safe examples for documentation
airlock.situation: Real payloads make good examples but contain data that cannot be published.
airlock.workflow: Pseudonymize identifying values while preserving formats, relationships and the overall shape of the example.
airlock.outcome: Create realistic teaching material without exposing live identities or secrets.

airlock.title: Review text before high-risk submission
airlock.situation: A long form or message is about to be sent and manually spotting every sensitive value is unreliable.
airlock.workflow: Run a final local scan, inspect each finding and apply sanitized values safely back to the form.
airlock.outcome: Add a deliberate privacy checkpoint without rebuilding the destination application.

clippilot.title: Understand copied JSON immediately
clippilot.situation: A large JSON payload is difficult to scan in a text field or temporary editor.
clippilot.workflow: Open ClipPilot to detect, beautify, browse as a tree, inspect schema and copy the transformed result.
clippilot.outcome: Move from raw payload to useful structure without searching for a separate formatter.

clippilot.title: Translate between technical formats
clippilot.situation: Copied data needs to become another representation before it can be used.
clippilot.workflow: Detect the source format and choose contextual conversion actions for structured data, requests or configuration.
clippilot.outcome: Reduce repetitive tool switching and transcription errors between systems.

clippilot.title: Inspect JWTs, URLs and cURL commands
clippilot.situation: A token or request must be understood quickly during debugging.
clippilot.workflow: Copy the content, review its detected components and use the relevant decode, inspect, clean or conversion action.
clippilot.outcome: Answer routine debugging questions while staying beside the current browser tab.

clippilot.title: Work safely with sensitive clipboard content
clippilot.situation: Clipboard data may contain secrets or personal information before transformation or AI use.
clippilot.workflow: Use local detection and redaction defaults, then explicitly decide whether a remote provider should receive sanitized content.
clippilot.outcome: Keep everyday clipboard productivity from becoming an invisible data-leak path.

clippilot.title: Transform content with local AI
clippilot.situation: A copied block needs explanation, restructuring or a custom transformation that deterministic actions do not cover.
clippilot.workflow: Send an explicit instruction to the selected local model and review the streamed result before copying it onward.
clippilot.outcome: Use contextual AI transformations without automatically uploading clipboard contents.

clippilot.title: Build a reusable clipboard knowledge trail
clippilot.situation: Useful transformed clips disappear after a task and have to be recreated later.
clippilot.workflow: Retain selected history, organize important clips and export or import collections where the plan permits.
clippilot.outcome: Turn transient clipboard work into a reusable personal workbench.

devrecall.title: Recall syntax by intent
devrecall.situation: The desired operation is clear, but the exact function, command or pattern is forgotten.
devrecall.workflow: Search in plain language and let aliases, language shortcuts, tags, notes and favorites rank concise references.
devrecall.outcome: Return to the task with a copy-ready answer instead of opening a chain of search results.

devrecall.title: Build a personal snippet memory
devrecall.situation: A useful solution has been found before, but it is scattered across notes, chats and old projects.
devrecall.workflow: Save the final snippet with folders, aliases, tags, favorites and context notes beside curated references.
devrecall.outcome: Make proven personal solutions easier to retrieve than rediscover.

devrecall.title: Diagnose recurring technical errors
devrecall.situation: An error message appears again, but the earlier diagnosis is no longer available.
devrecall.workflow: Use deterministic known-error guidance first, then invoke guarded AI only when the local knowledge does not cover it.
devrecall.outcome: Resolve familiar failures faster while keeping AI optional and reviewable.

devrecall.title: Create guarded page extractors
devrecall.situation: Values must be extracted from HTML, but selector quality and generated code safety are uncertain.
devrecall.workflow: Paste HTML inertly, validate CSS or XPath, preview actual matches and generate defensive console JavaScript.
devrecall.outcome: Build extraction recipes with clearer evidence and fewer unsafe side effects.

devrecall.title: Learn from repeated lookups
devrecall.situation: The same concepts are repeatedly searched but never become durable memory.
devrecall.workflow: Turn recurring references into focused learning cards delivered manually or on a chosen interval.
devrecall.outcome: Convert real work friction into small, relevant learning moments rather than another broad course.

devrecall.title: Share portable domain knowledge
devrecall.situation: A useful reference collection needs to move between users without a proprietary knowledge platform.
devrecall.workflow: Package searchable references, warnings, tags and learning cards into importable JSON code packs.
devrecall.outcome: Distribute focused technical knowledge in a format that remains inspectable and reusable.

morphogrid.title: Standardize recurring finance packs
morphogrid.situation: Monthly workbooks arrive with title rows, inconsistent cost centres, mixed date formats, duplicate references, and the same cleanup every period.
morphogrid.workflow: Remove introductory rows, promote the real header, normalize types, validate required IDs, deduplicate records, create a pivot, and save the sequence as a reusable recipe.
morphogrid.outcome: Produce a consistent, reviewable finance dataset faster while improving repeatability and auditability.

morphogrid.title: Clean CRM and pipeline exports
morphogrid.situation: Contact names, stages, territories, owner fields, emails, and phone numbers drift across CRM exports and undermine imports or dashboards.
morphogrid.workflow: Trim and standardize text, split or join fields, apply nested territory rules, fill required defaults, remove duplicates, and retain the workflow as a CRM hygiene recipe.
morphogrid.outcome: Create dependable account and contact data for territory planning, campaign handoff, pipeline review, or clean re-import.

morphogrid.title: Normalize vendor and procurement files
morphogrid.situation: Suppliers use different delimiters, SKU conventions, units, column names, and date or price formats.
morphogrid.workflow: Choose the source delimiter, map fields into a standard schema, clean SKUs with text or regex steps, convert types, join reference values, and export the required format.
morphogrid.outcome: Compare suppliers, inventory, pricing, and delivery performance without rebuilding formula chains for every vendor.

morphogrid.title: Turn survey and campaign exports into insights
morphogrid.situation: Free text, trailing spaces, inconsistent labels, and platform-specific columns hide the result needed for a meeting or performance review.
morphogrid.workflow: Clean text, normalize campaign or response labels, calculate shared metrics, profile columns, and turn sensible suggestions into pivots or charts.
morphogrid.outcome: Move from an untidy export to a decision-ready view while preserving an inspectable transformation path.

morphogrid.title: Prepare reproducible audit evidence
morphogrid.situation: Evidence extracts from multiple systems have inconsistent schemas, and manual edits are difficult to reproduce or defend.
morphogrid.workflow: Import without altering the original, apply explicit selection and validation steps, isolate exceptions with grouped filters, inspect removed-row samples, and export an Audit ZIP.
morphogrid.outcome: Deliver repeatable evidence preparation with clearer controls, diagnostics, and fewer silent spreadsheet changes.

morphogrid.title: Reshape API and system payloads locally
morphogrid.audience: Analysts, operators, and technical business users
morphogrid.situation: JSON, XML, or custom-delimited system output is machine-friendly but awkward to inspect, modify, or hand to another process.
morphogrid.workflow: Switch between native and table views, rename keys, calculate or join fields, validate records, optionally request local Ollama suggestions, and export back to the needed format.
morphogrid.outcome: Transform system data without uploading the full file, provisioning a database, or asking engineering to build a permanent pipeline for a recurring small job.
